zh.heroEyebrow: 新創公司 × 網頁開發
zh.heroSubtitle: 關於我們的服務、流程與合作方式，這裡有您需要的答案

items.question: 你們提供哪些網頁開發服務？
items.answer: 我們提供全端網頁開發，涵蓋企業品牌官網、電商平台、行動裝置優先的 RWD 設計，以及第三方 API 串接（金流、CRM、行銷工具等）。從設計稿到正式上線，每個環節都設有明確的里程碑與驗收點。

items.question: 一個專案的開發時間大約多久？
items.answer: 依專案規模而異。基礎品牌官網約 2–4 週；含後台的中型 SaaS 或電商通常需 6–12 週；大型客製化系統則依需求評估。我們在簽約前會提供詳細的時程規劃，確保進度完全透明，並設置明確的里程碑與驗收點。

items.question: 費用如何計算？有固定方案嗎？
items.answer: 我們採固定報價制，在需求確認後 7-10 個工作天內提供詳細估價單。費用涵蓋設計、開發、測試及部署，約定範圍內不追加費用。初次諮詢完全免費。

items.question: 如何開始合作？流程是什麼？
items.answer: 從您的角度，合作有四個關鍵節點：①免費需求諮詢（約 30–60 分鐘視訊）→ ②提案與報價（7-10 個工作天內）→ ③簽約啟動開發 → ④驗收上線與系統移交。我們內部採六步驟開發流程，確保每個環節都有明確的里程碑與驗收點。

items.question: 上線後有提供維護和更新服務嗎？
items.answer: 有的。我們提供三種維護方案：月費維護（含效能監控、安全更新、定期備份）、按需計費（適合偶爾有小更新需求）、以及功能擴展（重新需求訪談後評估）。維護費用與範圍於合作時書面確認。

items.question: 你們使用什麼技術開發？
items.answer: 前端採用 React / Next.js + TypeScript，後端使用 Node.js / Express，資料庫選用 PostgreSQL，檔案儲存使用 MinIO，部署採用 Vercel 或 Zeabur。所有程式碼透過 Git 進行版本控制，尾款付清後，程式碼著作權與帳號控制權移轉給您。

items.question: 開發中可以修改設計或需求嗎？
items.answer: 可以，但建議在設計稿確認前完成主要修改，以避免工期延誤。開發階段的小幅調整（色彩、文字、排版）通常可彈性配合；若涉及功能性需求變更，我們會重新評估時程與費用，並在雙方同意後執行，確保專案品質不受影響。

items.question: 資料隱私和安全如何保障？
items.answer: 我們依 OWASP Top 10 規範開發，針對 XSS、SQL Injection 等常見漏洞進行防護。所有敏感資料透過 HTTPS 加密傳輸，環境變數與金鑰絕不出現在原始碼中。尾款付清後，原始碼、資料庫及帳號控制權正式移轉給您。

en.heroSubtitle: Answers to your questions about our services, process, and collaboration
en.sectionHeading: What would you like to know?

items.question: What web development services do you offer?
items.answer: We provide full-stack web development including brand websites, e-commerce platforms, mobile-first RWD design, and third-party API integrations (payment gateways, CRMs, marketing tools, and more). From design mockup to live deployment, every phase has a defined milestone and acceptance checkpoint.

items.question: How long does a project typically take?
items.answer: It depends on scope. A basic brand website takes 2–4 weeks; a mid-size SaaS or e-commerce platform with an admin panel typically takes 6–12 weeks; large custom systems are evaluated case-by-case. We provide a detailed timeline before signing, with clear milestones and checkpoints to keep everything fully transparent.

items.question: How is pricing calculated? Are there fixed packages?
items.answer: We use fixed-price quotes. After confirming requirements, we deliver a detailed quote within 7-10 business days — covering design, development, testing, and deployment. No hidden fees within agreed scope. Initial consultations are completely free.

items.question: How do we get started? What's the process?
items.answer: From your perspective, collaboration has four key touchpoints: ① Free consultation (30–60 min video call) → ② Proposal and quote (within 7-10 business days) → ③ Contract signing and development kickoff → ④ Final review, launch, and system handoff. Our internal process follows a six-step development flow to ensure every phase has a clear milestone and acceptance checkpoint.

items.question: Do you offer maintenance and updates after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We offer three maintenance options: monthly retainer (includes performance monitoring, security updates, and regular backups), on-demand billing (pay-as-you-go for occasional updates), and feature expansion (re-scoped after a new requirements session). Maintenance scope and fees are confirmed in writing at the start of each engagement.

items.question: What technologies do you build with?
items.answer: Frontend: React / Next.js + TypeScript. Backend: Node.js / Express. Database: PostgreSQL. File storage: MinIO. Deployment: Vercel or Zeabur. All code is version-controlled via Git. Source code, database, and account ownership are transferred to you upon final payment.

items.question: Can we change the design or requirements during development?
items.answer: Yes — though we recommend finalizing major changes before the design is approved to avoid delays. Minor adjustments (colors, copy, layout tweaks) during development are usually flexible. Functional requirement changes are re-evaluated for timeline and cost, and only proceed once both parties agree, ensuring project quality is never compromised.

items.question: How do you protect our data and privacy?
items.answer: We develop to OWASP Top 10 standards, guarding against XSS, SQL Injection, and other common vulnerabilities. All sensitive data is encrypted in transit via HTTPS, and credentials or API keys never appear in source code. Source code, databases, and accounts are transferred to you upon final payment.
